{{Quote|I am Raklo-Mo. To me fell the task of breaking tradition. I saw a vision. The Empire and Republic destroyed Voss. I told the interpreters. The interpreters have grown lazy. The took the vision. They did not look at the details. They called the vision false - clearly, Voss was not destroyed. I stood on the Step of Harmony. If the Three did not retrain the interpreters, I would walk out of Voss-Ka. Since, interpreters have been trained better. We protected our art. It was threatened by outside influences. My vision showed it.|[[Writings of Raklo-Mo]]|<ref name="March of Time">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|March of Time|[[Voss]]}}</ref>}}
'''Raklo-Mo''' was a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] living on [[Voss]] shortly after their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society. They saw a vision of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] posing a mortal threat to Voss, which the [[Interpreter (Voss)|interpreters]] had deemed false. Raklo-Mo stood on a platform called the [[Step of Harmony]] and threatened to take a step out of [[Voss-Ka]] onto the cliffs below, which led the [[Three]] to retraining the interpreters, who this time correctly identified the vision as a threat to Voss culture, not the planet itself. Raklo-Mo recorded the event in the [[Writings of Raklo-Mo]] on a carving outside the [[Shrine of Healing]] in the [[Old Paths]].
